prompt_text: 10-second static shot of a sunlit park path lined with a long row of dark wooden benches. At the far end, a woman in a white top and shorts sits with her legs crossed beside a seated woman with a blonde ponytail, sunglasses and a dark blue top. Over the first 2.5 seconds the woman in white uncrosses her legs and plants both sandaled feet on the pavement. She then puts a hand on the bench and leans forward, and from about 4.5 to 7.5 seconds she pushes up smoothly to stand fully upright in front of the bench. In the last seconds she takes one small settling step and turns slightly toward her companion, who stays seated and lifts her head a little. The benches, the bicycle parked in shade at left and the camera all stay still.

She puts a hand on the bench seat or armrest beside her and leans her torso forward, bringing her weight over her feet while her hips are still on the seat.
She pushes up off the bench, straightening her knees and hips smoothly until she stands fully upright in front of it. Both feet stay planted and her hand leaves the bench as she rises.
Standing in front of the bench, she takes one small settling step and turns slightly toward her companion. The woman with the ponytail stays seated and lifts her head a little toward her.
